jyutping: ci5 daai6 zoeng6 gam2 joeng2 ge3 N

english.note: Use this before a noun when something resembles an elephant in appearance or a particular feature.

examples.english: They have elephantine ears that you can spot from far away.
examples.traditional: 佢有對似大象咁樣嘅大耳仔，遠遠都睇得出。
